newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes firm on light short covering.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes firm on light short covering.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed firm on small lot short covering tied to position squaring before the weekend, traders said.
Traders said gains in the market continue to be stymied by weakness in the Asian cash market, especially in the benchmark Thai market.
Rice closed two to nine cents per cwt higher, with November up 7-1/2 at $10.14-1/2.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 250 contracts, down from 545 Thursday.
